settings.title: Settings

telegram.description: Notifications about birthdays, payments and projects
telegram.notConfigured: The bot is not configured on the server: set TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN in .env and restart the API.
telegram.afterStart: Press “Start” in the bot chat that opened, then “Check”.

guide.1: In Telegram, open @BotFather, send /newbot and follow it: you get the token of your own bot.
guide.2: Put the token into the server's .env as TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and restart the dashboard.
guide.3: Press “Connect Telegram” here, then “Start” in the chat with the bot, then “Check”.

profile.title: Profile
profile.timeZoneHint: Taken from this device by itself: reminders, due dates and the digest follow your clock.

sync.title: Sync
sync.description: Two copies of the dashboard: this computer and the server
sync.off: Sync is off: this dashboard works on its own. To keep a copy on a server and use it away from this computer, see docs/sync.md.
sync.server: This is the server. It runs the Telegram bot and background jobs; your computer syncs with it.
sync.client: This computer syncs with {{url}}. Without internet everything keeps working and syncs later.
sync.mismatch: The data here differs from the server's. "Resync everything" usually mends it:
sync.confirmResync: Walk through all data of both sides again? Everything missing on either side is sent over; it may take a few minutes.
sync.confirmDismissAll: Keep the current rows and forget all the versions that lost?
sync.kept: Brought back — it will reach the other side with the next sync
sync.parentGone: What this row belonged to no longer exists
sync.parkedTitle: Changes that could not be applied

backup.title: Backups
backup.latestCopy: Latest copy of the server's backup here: {{time}}, {{size}} MB ({{count}} kept)
backup.restoreOk: Test restore {{time}}: {{tables}} tables, {{rows}} rows — all in place
backup.restoreMismatch: The test restore lost rows in {{table}}: {{restored}} of {{live}}
backup.copied: The backup copy is up to date

server.missing: No dumps yet — is the backup container running?
server.stale: The newest dump is more than a day old — is the backup container running?
server.unchecked: No test restore for more than a week.
server.restore-failed: The latest test restore did not go well.

client.missing: No copy of the server's backup on this computer yet.
client.stale: The newest copy here is several days old.
client.unchecked: The server has not test-restored a dump for more than a week.
client.restore-failed: The server's latest test restore did not go well.

security.title: Security
security.off: Off: signing in needs only the password.
security.scan: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Aegis…) and enter the code it shows.
security.manual: Or enter the key by hand:
security.codesHint: Recovery codes: each signs in once when your phone is not at hand. Save them somewhere safe — they are shown only now.

trash.title: Trash
trash.subtitle: Deleted in the last 30 days — by you or by the AI assistant
trash.confirmForever: Delete this for good? It cannot be restored then.
trash.parentFirst: Restore what it belonged to first (for example, the project)
